prose: Simon Willison reports from GitHub Universe that the conference badge is a full color-screen computer, and that Steve Francia - working with Gemini - got a NES emulator running on it, then went further and deployed Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulators. With the right ROM, the badge plays The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening, and flipping the badge upside down puts its touch buttons in game-controller position.
highlights: GitHub Universe badge runs Game Boy Color emulation
Steve Francia built NES then GB/GBC emulators with Gemini's help
Badge flips upside down for controller-style touch buttons
Light link-post; AI angle is Gemini-assisted emulation hacking
